scope: Independent visual review of the matched native 1080 baseline/candidate EV8 images and two native crop comparisons; no shader edit, GPU run, or D/E write.

road.net_benefit: Clear positive for the targeted artificial black strips. Broad rectangular black gaps on the middle and distant road disappear and the pavement receives spatially continuous illumination.
road.specific_tradeoff: Across approximately x850..1200,y630..820, apparent cobblestone relief also becomes much flatter. The road reads closer to a smooth paved surface. Nearer thin joints remain visible, so this is not a full-image blur, but unchanged texture fidelity cannot be claimed.
road.interpretation_limit: The removed absolute-black bands were already identified as unsupported shading-normal events, so their former contrast is not automatically legitimate material detail. Nevertheless, the candidate's flatter material appearance is a visible model tradeoff.
road.unchanged_or_unresolved: The puddle around x790..1030,y770..835 retains its patchy reflection. Frontmost cobble geometry, curb steps and post silhouettes remain distinguishable; the targeted fix does not establish water or overall noise quality.

largest_change.location: A dark interruption at the edge of the left wall-mounted lantern, immediately beside its bright shade.
largest_change.visual_read: The new value joins the neighboring bright lamp edge rather than appearing as a detached isolated spark. The 64x64 comparison does not show a new extended halo or a new unrelated bright object.
largest_change.limit: A coherent location and finite HDR value support plausible restored visible lighting; they do not by themselves prove the exact radiance is physically correct.

foliage.visual_read: New yellow-green bright fragments lie along the upper-right foliage contour and connect to existing leaf clusters. No obvious pixels outside the silhouette become a light halo in the reviewed crop.
foliage.tradeoff: The density of bright leaf fragments visibly increases and the tree looks more sparkling. This is broader than the road repair and should remain an explicit collateral change.
foliage.limit: Single-frame appearance cannot distinguish all physically restored leaf lighting from excessive normal adaptation or demonstrate temporal stability. It is not enough to label all new bright values either fireflies or correct highlights.

decision: Keep and present the toggleable candidate as an effective repair of the road black-strip failure, with flatter mid-distance road detail and increased foliage highlights stated. Do not mark universal primary-opaque quality or absence of regressions as passed. The targeted road benefit is stronger than any clearly demonstrated local visual failure in these four comparisons, but the broader material adaptation remains a candidate.
numeric_context: full_frame_stats.json reports unchanged global maximum HDR value, finite data and no negative channels. These are boundedness checks, not image-quality acceptance.
